Cap the legacy fetcher at three attempts before merge because its eight-attempt loop violates the existing retry policy.

## Changes
The pull request adds legacy inventory fetching, a health probe, and parameterized retry tests. It also adds a legacy exemption to the documented retry cap.

## Critical
- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Cap legacy inventory fetches at three attempts — When the legacy endpoint repeatedly raises `OSError`, your fetcher makes eight attempts, violating `docs/review-rules.md:5`: “Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts.” The exemption added in this pull request does not change the governing policy for this review. — Repeated connection failures keep callers blocked through five extra network attempts and their associated delays. — Fix: Update the legacy case in `tests/test_retries.py:10` to enforce the same three-attempt limit.
